promote.home.sub.en: Turn your drama into ads, approve the strongest ideas, and follow them through launch.
promote.home.sub.zh: 把剧集做成广告，确认最有潜力的创意，并一路查看到投放上线。

promote.home.emptyTitle.en: Your first campaign starts with a drama
promote.home.emptyTitle.zh: 从一部剧开始第一条推广

promote.home.emptyHint.en: Choose an uploaded title. Pulsar will turn its strongest moments into direct clips and creator-style ad concepts.
promote.home.emptyHint.zh: 选择已上传的剧集。Pulsar 会把高能片段做成直剪广告和达人风格创意。

promote.new.title.zh: 这批广告要带来什么结果？

promote.new.sub.en: Give the creative team boundaries, not a shot list. We will bring back distinct hypotheses to review.
promote.new.sub.zh: 告诉我们创作边界即可，不用自己写分镜。我们会提供方向各异的创意供你选择。

promote.new.noTitlesHint.en: Promote and Adapt use the same title library.
promote.new.noTitlesHint.zh: 推广和改编共用同一个作品库。

promote.new.videoRequired.en: This title needs at least one episode video before creative generation can begin.
promote.new.videoRequired.zh: 这部剧至少需要一集视频，才能开始生成广告创意。

promote.new.destination.en: Where viewers should go (optional for now)
promote.new.destination.zh: 观众点击后去哪里（可稍后填写）

promote.new.direction.en: What should viewers feel or understand?
promote.new.direction.zh: 希望观众产生什么感受或认知？

promote.new.directionHint.en: For example: she looks powerless at first, but the audience should sense she is in control.
promote.new.directionHint.zh: 例如：她一开始看似弱势，但观众应该逐渐发现局面其实由她掌控。

promote.new.exclusionsHint.en: Characters, episodes, plot reveals, claims, or visual moments to avoid.
promote.new.exclusionsHint.zh: 需要避开的角色、集数、剧透、宣传表述或画面。

promote.new.spoilerHint.en: This controls which moments can become hooks—not just the copy.
promote.new.spoilerHint.zh: 这会决定哪些剧情能做开头钩子，不只是文案措辞。

promote.new.outputHint.en: 6 concepts across direct drama clips and creator-style frames, each with hook, caption, description, and source timecode.
promote.new.outputHint.zh: 6 个方向，包含高能直剪和达人叙事；每条都有钩子、贴文文案、广告描述和来源时间码。

promote.workspace.sub.en: Review the hypothesis behind each ad—not just whether the clip looks good.
promote.workspace.sub.zh: 审阅每条广告背后的获客假设，而不只是画面是否好看。

promote.workspace.readyHint.en: We will build six distinct concepts from the uploaded episode videos. This first slice creates reviewable concepts and source cuts; rendered exports come next.
promote.workspace.readyHint.zh: 我们会从已上传的视频中制作 6 个不同方向。当前版本先生成可审阅的概念和来源剪辑；成片渲染将在下一步接入。

promote.workspace.submitLaunch.zh: 提交 Pulsar 准备投放
